projection: WGS84 local ENU tangent plane; ellipsoid-intersection raster sampling
vertical_datum: Source DEM heights used as approximate WGS84 altitude; no geoid conversion
imagery_native_resolution: Variable by source; output sampling does not imply native accuracy
dem_source: Mapzen Terrain Tiles (Terrarium), zoom 12, approx. 32 m pixel spacing at center
imagery_attribution: Source: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
imagery_texture_sharing: 500 m mesh tiles reference georeferenced subregions of 16 shared imagery textures
